scene: The clanking cabin sways gently as gears hum beneath the floor.
beats: Inside rests a tame clockwork cricket that chirps cheerfully just as the crawler docks at Gear Bridge and the doors slide open.
She trades a shiny gear token for your comet rumor, then gives the whistle a cheerful toot as the doors open at Gear Bridge.
Sweet cinnamon steam puffs into the cabin with a soft hiss, just as the crawler glides into Gear Bridge and the doors open wide.
picture: Side view inside the crawler cabin. On the far left sits a passenger bench under a luggage rack holding a shaking wicker basket. The player stands centre with telescope slung. To the right, an apron-clad conductor polishes a brass horn beside a wall mounted with a shiny steam pipe and brass dial.
shown: a vibrating wicker trunk tied with purple string up high on the left rack
a conductor in an apron polishing a brass horn, seated on the right
a polished brass wheel on a rattling steam pipe on the far right

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the crawler rumbles past, rocking like a cradle. At the line's end, a squeaky window-cleaner gondola whisks you up into the swirling cloud tanks of Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: The warm cabin rattles softly along the tracks under the glow of amber lamps.
beats: A friendly clockwork cricket peeks from the trunk with a tiny chirp, right as the crawler halts and doors open at Gear Bridge.
You trade stories about the comet for a polished gear token, and she blasts a merry note as the doors slide open at Gear Bridge.
Warm cinnamon-scented vapor hisses from the valve in a cozy cloud, just as the crawler pulls into Gear Bridge and doors slide open.
variants.ride_on: You keep your seat as the car hums forward. At the final stop, an old window-cleaner gondola carries you upward into the misty cloud tanks of Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: Rhythmic clicks tick beneath the floorboards as you hum {tune} to yourself.
beats: The lid quivers to reveal a metal cricket singing happily, just as your train brakes at Gear Bridge and the doors slide apart.
She gladly gives you a brass token for your rooftop rumor, sounding a bright brass whistle as the doors slide open at Gear Bridge.
A gentle puff of cinnamon steam billows into the air, right as the crawler glides up to Gear Bridge and the doors open.
variants.ride_on: Remaining aboard as the wheels rumble along, you reach the end of the line, where a creaking window-cleaner gondola lifts you straight up into Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: Overhead handles sway in unison as evening commuters rest in the rumbling car.
beats: Inside, a mechanical cricket chimes out a lively tune, just as the crawler eases into Gear Bridge and the train doors glide open.
In exchange for news of the comet, she offers a shiny gear token and plays a friendly toot as the doors open at Gear Bridge.
Spicy cinnamon vapor whistles softly into the car, right as the crawler rolls into Gear Bridge and its doors slide wide open.
variants.ride_on: You ride past the stop, rocked by the train's steady sway. At the route's end, a squeaking window-cleaner gondola floats you into the swirling mist of Rainmaker Rooftops.
